explanation: The AI response failed to identify Trinidad & Tobago, Malta, and Barbados (which are republics with female presidents acting as heads of state as of June 2024, except Barbados which had Dame Sandra Mason, President/Head of State). Dominica was included. The AI included several Commonwealth realms where the monarch (King Charles III) is the actual head of state (represented by female Governors-General) such as Bahamas, Grenada, St. Vincent and the Grenadines, and St. Kitts and Nevis.
